name: Search result
summary: One row of a search results list: the title with the searched words marked, the category tag and date, and a two-line plain-text blurb with URLs stripped. Ships as a web component and as a class layer (lib/search-result.css) a host such as a Discourse theme applies to its own markup.
highlights: Searched words marked on Vivid Pink at 5% in ink
Category tag, date, two-line blurb with URLs stripped
Web component, or a class layer for Discourse
lead: ONE custom element, <aha-search-result>, plus the same CSS as a class layer. The row is the title (a link, 16/600 ink), a meta row with the category <aha-tag> and the date (14/400 tertiary), then the blurb (14/400 secondary, plain text, clamped to two lines). Every word of `query` is marked in the title and the blurb: a Vivid Pink at 5% fill (--aha-bg-accent) with ink text, the weight of the text around it. The blurb drops URLs (http, https and www links) before it renders, so a pasted link never eats the two lines. 16px vertical padding and a 1px --aha-border-secondary divider; the last row drops it. Two ways in: a page that builds its own results list uses the element; a host that renders its own result markup (Discourse full-page search, .fps-result) links lib/search-result.css, which carries the same rules with each Discourse class listed beside its DS class. The element and the file share one stylesheet (lib/search-result-css.js), so they cannot drift. The category slot uses <aha-tag> until the category chip lands.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS, identical render. React and Vue pass attributes to the custom element. The class layer lib/search-result.css is generated from the element's own stylesheet, so a Discourse theme and the element render the same row. stripUrls() is exported for hosts that clean a blurb themselves.

spec.label: Row
spec.value: title, meta row, blurb in a column with 4px gaps · padding 16 top and bottom · divider 1px border-secondary #F1F1F1, none on the last row

spec.label: Title
spec.value: 16px / 1.5 · SemiBold 600 · text-default #1A1A1A · a link, underline on hover, 2px border-focus ring on keyboard focus

spec.label: Match
spec.value: each word of `query`, in the title and the blurb · bg-accent (Vivid Pink at 5%, #E70E680D) fill, text-default #1A1A1A ink, the surrounding weight, radius 4 · a <mark> element

spec.label: Category
spec.value: <aha-tag> first in the meta row, links to the category (the category chip replaces it when it ships)

spec.label: Date
spec.value: 14px / 1.5 · Regular 400 · text-tertiary #616161 · a <time> element, 8px after the category

spec.label: Blurb
spec.value: 14px / 1.5 · Regular 400 · text-secondary #4A4A4A · plain text, URLs stripped, two lines then an ellipsis

spec.label: Result count
spec.value: the count beside a search field is a total: the default Badge count, white on black #1A1A1A, 11/18 SemiBold, 18px pill, never a Vivid Pink fill (Badge, Count colour)

props.name: result-title
props.desc: The result's title, rendered as text in the title link with the query words marked

props.name: href
props.desc: Where the title links (the topic or post)

props.name: query
props.desc: The search terms. Each word is marked, case-insensitive, in the title and the blurb; omit to mark nothing

props.name: category
props.desc: Category name shown as a tag in the meta row; omit for no tag

props.name: category-href
props.desc: Makes the category tag a link

props.name: blurb
props.desc: Plain text, set as text (never parsed as HTML). URLs are stripped and the rest is clamped to two lines

whenToUse.when: a list of results for a typed search: forum search, help-centre search, a template search page
the host renders its own result markup and cannot swap it for an element (Discourse full-page search)
a topic list with no search term: latest, a category, with avatar, likes and replies
uniform rows of anything else with a title and a short description

opinion.note: Mark only the searched words, never a whole phrase or the row. The mark is a fill, not a weight or a colour change, so a match reads the same in a SemiBold title and a Regular blurb. Pass the blurb as plain text. A result count beside the search field is the default black Badge count. In Discourse use the class layer on Discourse's own markup (see the Discourse tab).
opinion.dsv3: EXTENSION — DS V3 has no search results row. Built from the Topic row and List conventions (title link, tertiary meta, secondary two-line text, row dividers) with the selected-state fill, Vivid Pink at 5% (--aha-bg-accent, colour rule 3.7), as the match mark; reuses <aha-tag>.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the rendered element (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). The probe row has a query that matches the title and the blurb, a category, a date and a blurb with a URL, so every slot renders and the URL strip is proven.
